why: Both subsections of PILOT_REPORT_3 are pre-specified so neither split can be drawn around the result.
polar_definition: The question's answer space has two sides (yes/no, or an explicit A-or-B alternative). B10.5 forces every distractor to CONFLICT with the true position, so on such a question all three distractors land on the opposite side and the true option is the lone dissenter. If the gate solves these at higher margins than the wh-questions, 'pick the odd one out' is doing the work.
register_definition: Capitalised-entity-token overlap between each option and the question. delta = true option's overlap minus the mean distractor's. A positive delta means the true option echoes the question's own naming more than the distractors do, which is the A4.1 tell.
bar_lock_items: Contradiction-rule refinement: require POSITION DIVERSITY among the three distractors on polar questions, so they do not all collapse onto one side. Design item for bar-lock, NOT a re-run of this pilot.

Generation-prompt refinement: instruct the generator to match the true answer's naming register relative to the question (if the question names countries, the alternatives name countries, not capital cities). Design item for bar-lock, NOT a re-run.
